# Ace Yash

> Ace Yash is a developer based in Varanasi, India, and the founder and CEO of The Ace Base. This site is his personal portfolio: who he is, what he builds, and how to reach him.

## Identity

- Name: Ace Yash
- Role: Developer
- Leadership: Founder & CEO of The Ace Base
- Location: Varanasi, India
- Website: https://aceyash-dev.github.io/
- Email: hello@ace-base.cc
- GitHub: https://github.com/aceyash-dev
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/archives.of.yash

## The Ace Base

The Ace Base (https://ace-base.cc/) builds software and digital infrastructure across web applications, typography, developer tools, and user interfaces. Ace Yash founded it and leads product, engineering, and interface direction.

- Company site: https://ace-base.cc/
- Documentation: https://docs.ace-base.cc/
- Typace (typography organizer): https://typace.ace-base.cc/

## What he builds

- The Ace Base — software and digital infrastructure studio (ace-base.cc)
- Typace — a focused typography organizer (typace.ace-base.cc)
- AceMail — native Android SMTP/IMAP email client (https://github.com/tab-gl/AceMail)
- Browser widgets — standalone weather, clock, and calendar tools (/widgets/ on this site)
- This portfolio — React, TypeScript, Vite; prerendered; hosted on GitHub Pages

## Technologies

JavaScript, TypeScript, React, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS, Vite, Node.js, Android SDK, Git, GitHub Actions.
